title: Derandomizing Dense Binary Hypervector Codebooks for Quantized Scalars
abstract: arXiv:2609.38471v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Hyperdimensional computing and vector symbolic architectures often represent quantized scalar levels by dense binary codebooks whose level-to-level similarity is intended to follow a prescribed function of scalar separation. At finite dimensionality, randomized scalar codebook constructions deviate from this target because of sampling noise, random-start imbalance, update-count fluctuations, component dependence, and finite-capacity effects. We develop a transition-based derandomization framework for dense binary scalar codebooks across two target-similarity families, with similarity decaying exponentially or linearly with level separation. The framework separates the target similarity law, the derandomization variant, and the concrete generator construction, making explicit how initialization, selection, update, and capacity-handling mechanisms shape the induced similarity profile. translated_title: 面向量化标量的密集二元超向量码本去随机化
translated_abstract: 超维计算与向量符号架构通常使用密集二进制码本来表示量化标量层级，其层级间相似度旨在遵循标量间隔的某一预定函数。在有限维度下，随机化的标量码本构建会因采样噪声、随机起始不平衡、更新次数波动、分量相关性以及有限容量效应而偏离这一目标。我们针对密集二进制标量码本开发了一个基于转换的去随机化框架，涵盖两类目标相似度族——相似度随层级间隔呈指数或线性衰减。该框架将目标相似度规律、去随机化变体与具体的生成器构建分离开来，明确揭示了初始化、选择、更新及容量处理机制如何塑造所诱导的相似度轮廓。我们形式化了若干分别……的去随机化变体（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个基于转换的去随机化框架，用于构建密集二元标量超向量码本，将目标相似度规律、去随机化变体与生成器构建解耦，从而精确控制层级间诱导的相似度轮廓。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a transition-based derandomization framework for dense binary scalar hypervector codebooks, decoupling the target similarity law, derandomization variant, and generator construction to precisely control the induced level-to-level similarity profile.
